veranderings.voor: Ons noem elke stuk ys in hael 'n haelkorrel.
veranderings.na: Ons noem elke stuk hael 'n haelkorrel.
veranderings.rede: 'elke stuk ys in hael' is wooden; the previous sentence already says hail is pieces of ice.
'Duik slaan' is the idiomatic Afrikaans expression; 'duike in motors maak' is a calque.
